Warm-up

Say it the exam way

The magnetic induction near a long straight wire is proportional to the current. It is proportional to the distance from the wire. The constant μ₀ is the permeability of .

The force on a wire is F = IlB sin θ, where θ is the angle between the wire and the . The force is greatest when the wire is at to the field. When the current is to the field, there is no force. Two parallel wires carrying current in the same direction . The unit of force per unit length is .

Errors that cost marks

  • No force when the current is parallel to B.
